links.comparator_used: Black-box stacked meta-ensemble (no post-hoc explanation needed for EBM)
links.outcome: Discrimination (AUC) for severe tooth loss on NHANES 2015-2018 cross-domain validation
links.effect: Zero-shot EBM AUC 0.7591 vs black-box stacked meta-ensemble AUC 0.7706
links.tradeoff: The black-box ensemble had a slightly higher AUC (0.7706 vs 0.7591). The interpretable EBM gave fully auditable shape functions and pairwise interactions.
links.quote: Notably, the zero-shot EBM (AUC: 0.7591) closely matched the predictive ceiling of a black-box stacked meta-ensemble (AUC: 0.7706), eliminating the need for unstable post-hoc approximations.

design_hint: recalibration before deployment on external data
